svg.title: Blood pressure readings in bands
svg.desc: Four bands from lowest to highest. Below 120 over 80 is normal. 120 to 139 over 80 to 89 is above the ideal and should be rechecked. 140 over 90 or higher is hypertension in Indian and European guidelines, confirmed on repeated readings. 180 over 120 or higher with symptoms is an emergency.
svg.text: Severe headache, chest pain, breathlessness, vision change, confusion or weakness: call 112 or go to hospital.
140/90 or higher: hypertension (Indian and European guidelines)
Confirmed on repeated readings, not one. US guidelines use 130/80. Your doctor decides what to do.
Recheck on another day. Salt, weight, activity, sleep and stress matter most here.
Keep checking at the interval your doctor advises.
Either number can put you in a higher band. Targets are personal. See the chapter for how to measure correctly.
